structure: Single high school course. Header u1 gives 'Grade/Course: European Studies / ACCN: CHR2200'. Pages are series of small tables: Strand (European Studies) + Standard heading: 'Standard N: ...'; per benchmark a table with Topic, benchmark text and code (Benchmark SS.ES.n.m), Sample Performance (example task), 'Assessment (SPA)' and a 4-level Rubric (Advanced/Proficient/Partially Proficient/Novice in C1-C4). Rubric sentences sometimes split across page breaks.
issues: Rubric rows and 'Assessment (SPA)' labels labeled backup as assessment material; 'Sample Performance' tasks labeled examples.
Course has no stated grade; assigned 9-12.
u221: second 'Standard 4: Understand European economic issues' heading (u219-u221) precedes benchmarks SS.ES.5.1-5.4; apparently a typo for Standard 5 in the source.
u235-u242: rubric row split across page break (backup).
